title: Connect all Claude members to the Mixpanel MCP Server with managed authorization
summary: Mixpanel MCP Server now supports beta auto-connect for Claude.ai users with managed authorization, enabling seamless and secure integration.
body_markdown:
MCP Server: Auto-connect


[Claude.ai](http://claude.ai/) users with managed authorization (beta)


✨


Admins can now connect Claude to the Mixpanel MCP Server for every member at once. When members open Claude, Mixpanel is already connected, with no sign-in or consent screen. With this update:


What's new


-


One-time setup:


A Claude admin and a Mixpanel org admin connect the two. In Claude, use the connector's


Managed authorization


settings. In Mixpanel, go to


Organization Settings → Access Security → Claude Access


.


-


Choose the identity provider:


Use Claude as the issuer for the fastest setup, or use Okta so its sign-in and MFA policies apply and you control who gets access.


-


Your permissions stay the same:


Claude acts as each member, and Mixpanel checks their project and data access on every request. Managed authorization grants no extra access.


-


Every connection is audited:


Each connection appears in the


[audit log](https://docs.mixpanel.com/docs/access-security/audit-log#audit-log) as an


mcp_client.authorized


entry, and changes to the issuer setup are logged as


trusted_identity_issuer.*


entries.


Availability


Managed authorization (also called Enterprise Managed Auth) is in Beta on all Mixpanel plans, including Free. It requires a Claude Team or Enterprise plan. Your Mixpanel organization also needs MCP enabled and a claimed email domain that matches the emails members use in Claude.


👉


[Learn more](https://docs.mixpanel.com/docs/mcp/claude-enterprise-managed-auth)
